instruction: Integrate GitLens into your Visual Studio Code environment.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing the GitLens extension in VS Code. Uses existing is_extension_installed metric to verify that 'eamodio.gitlens' appears in the output of 'code --list-extensions'. No custom functions needed as the existing evaluator handles this pattern perfectly.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses vm_command_line getter to execute 'code --list-extensions | grep eamodio.gitlens' which is the standard method to check installed VS Code extensions
Metric function is_extension_installed correctly handles expected parameter - receives rules dict directly and accesses rules['type'] and rules['expected'] (correct pattern for type='rule')
Logic flow is semantically correct: command outputs extension ID if installed, metric checks for containment of 'eamodio.gitlens' in output
Expected value 'eamodio.gitlens' is the correct official extension ID for GitLens
Complete coverage: instruction requires installing GitLens, evaluator verifies GitLens is in the installed extensions list
Practical feasibility: command will work at runtime and correctly detect installation status
